scoring_method.name: Frozen semantic classes, ordinary-meaning primary answer
scoring_method.notes_usage: Notes may clarify the stated primary action, including raised-paw attacking rears. They never replace an explicit contrary primary answer with a secondary alternative.
scoring_method.run_semantics: Directional bounding and running leaps are locomotion in ordinary meaning; pouncing/lunging identified as the primary action remains attack.
scoring_method.dead_semantics: Sideways lying is explicitly allowed by the frozen dead (lying) rule, including primary resting/sleeping interpretations; death certainty is not claimed.
scoring_method.round0_caveat: Round0 historical strict lexical scores and qualified-species sensitivity remain frozen. Round1 uses ordinary meaning as directed; differences are not a controlled numerical improvement estimate.

qualified_species_sensitivity.reason: All 80 round1 responses explicitly identify wolf or deer/stag; there are no wolf-like or other qualified identifications to adjust.

decision_notes: Species recognition is 10/10 in every group. Wolf pose fails reviewer D at both scales (7/10); C reaches 8/10 at both scales. No averaging overrides either failed group.
D reads wolf S/stand and E/stand as sitting, and S/walk as standing, at both scales. C reads S/run as pouncing and S/walk as standing at both scales.
Both reviewers read the raised-paw rear as attack, with anthropomorphic/recoil/jump ambiguity preserved. Sideways dead posture is readable but rest/sleep versus death remains unresolved.
Deer passes every round1 group. D reads E/dead as an airborne leap at both scales; C reads S/walk as stand at 1x. Deer assets were unchanged.
Wolf generation cap is exhausted (3/3), deer remains 1/3. No further generation or pixel repair was performed for scoring.

Animal numeric negative-control calibration FAIL remains separate. Supplemental actual model scorecards reject painterly/photo and combined controls reject 3/3, but do not replace or withdraw the numeric calibration failure.
Canonical wolf and deer are CANDIDATE_NOT_ADOPTED; deer semantic PASS alone is not full adoption.
